active_problem: Post-merge production verification reproduced the user's Streamlit ReadTimeout on the first cold Kyre Sports API slate request even though the immediately following warmed request returned the full slate in 6.88 seconds. The Streamlit gateway made only one request and therefore surfaced the transient cold start directly as an error.
solution: Keep the optimized server/data path frozen and add exactly one bounded gateway retry only for requests.ReadTimeout: 10-second cold attempt followed by one 15-second retry. Preserve fail-fast behavior for other request errors and never allow a third attempt.
